Hooks for vendors: post-merger harmonisation of parent apps across France (LPCR + Liveli), UK and Germany; occupancy and staffing pressure in the UK; IGAS/regulatory scrutiny of French private crèches since 2023-2024 creating demand for quality-reporting tools. Group decisions are centralised in Paris with strong country MDs; sell at group CDO level for platform deals and at country MD level for pilots.
